name: Sarah McBride

accounts.evidence: The official House site links x.com/Rep_McBride in its social media list.
Her official campaign website links twitter.com/SarahEMcBride under 'Connect with us'.

notes: SarahEMcBride is linked from the campaign site but appears to be her long-standing personal account; it could also be classed as a campaign account.

name: Jimmy Patronis

accounts.evidence: The official House site links x.com/PatronisFL in the header, the footer and the 'Stay Connected' section.
A Daily Caller News Foundation article embeds a 25 November 2024 post from @JimmyPatronis replying to Trump's endorsement: 'Put me to work, Mr. President!'

notes: The campaign site jimmypatronis.com failed to load because of a certificate error, so I could not confirm a separate campaign handle. The JimmyPatronis evidence dates from November 2024, when he was Florida's Chief Financial Officer; I did not confirm that the account is still active.

name: Randy Fine

accounts.evidence: The official House site links x.com/RepFine in its header and footer social menus.
The 'Randy Fine for Congress' campaign site, paid for by Randy Fine for Congress, links x.com/VoteRandyFine.

notes: randyfine.com is a parked domain that is for sale, so it is not his site. I did not look for a separate personal account.
